snippet.title: ELEVATOR: AVICI - Retro Hong Kong Lo-Fi Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 WISHLIST & FOLLOW THE GAME HERE:
👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4790520/___ELEVATOR_AVICI/
👉 Follow on Itch.io: https://nasu173.itch.io/elevator-avici

👁️ ABOUT THIS GAME 
"A vertical shaft, endless in space, ceaseless in torment—this is Avici."

ELEVATOR: AVICI is a first-person psychological horror game wrapped in a gritty, retro Hong Kong lo-fi aesthetic.

The story roots itself in the shadowy corners of modern Hong Kong. At 2:00 AM, you are just an ordinary delivery worker, stepping into a derelict apartment building for one last routine order. Waiting for you is a classic, clanking cage elevator—the kind you've ridden a thousand times before, smelling faintly of machine oil and decay. But this time, the doors close, and the descent into the abyss begins.

My Second Project: This is my second indie horror game.

Playtime: Approximately 15–30 minutes (depending on your exploration).

Multiple Endings: Features 3 completely distinct endings.

Survive & Escape: Whether you can escape depends entirely on your reasoning and keen observation of details.
